newsitem.title: USA: Wabash National completes debt placement.
newsitem.headline: Wabash National completes debt placement.

text.p: Wabash National Corp said Thursday it completed the private placement of $100 million in senior notes due 2001 to 2008.

The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes and to reduce the cost of capital at Wabash National Finance Corp, a wholly owned subsidiary, by repaying a portion of its higher-cost debt, the company said.

"The new capital structure of our finance company will provide the capital to allow us to continue the growth of our leasing portfolio while lowering the finance company's cost of capital by 15 percent," Donald Ehrlich, chairman, president and chief executive of Wabash National, said in a statement.
Salomon Brothers Inc was the exclusive agent in the placement, Wabash National said.
Wabash National provides standard and customized truck trailers.
